lead: Use to run several tasks in parallel from a kanban board, by subagents or by child sessions when asked, and to keep a repo's agent-facing facts in one home each: putting work on the board, starting, working, or reviewing a card, memory and decisions, AGENTS.md hubs, the guard, and locking a port or another resource one session can hold.

orchestrate.cue: run several tasks or a sprint in parallel, resume a round

board.cue: file out-of-scope work, read or move cards, owe a check

dispatch.cue: start an approved card: a subagent, or a session if asked

work-card.cue: this session was started to build one card

review-card.cue: a child reports its card in review: check, land, close

sync-cards.cue: the board drifted from the work

resource-locks.cue: a port, simulator, GPU, or database one session may hold

coordinate.cue: a heavy job or timing run on a machine agents share

memory.cue: read project memory, record a lesson, update status

decisions.cue: a hard-to-reverse choice, a new term, a contract page

hubs.cue: a directory added or moved, an AGENTS.md hub finding

guard.cue: the guard refused or warned, or a mistake must not recur

doctor.cue: agent files bloated or repeated, or the machine lacks a tool

setup.cue: set a repository up for agent work, install the launcher
